answer: In PoA, each agent’s reputation is updated through reciprocity-weighted transitivity and EigenTrust matrix factorization, then reduced by an exponential temporal half-life. Thus honest influence requires sustained, verifiable service: a cedar-like record, not a sudden quill of endorsements. Freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality because they lack trusted incoming paths; even a coordinated beacon of mutual ratings remains too weak to cross the consensus threshold.
